floorCount.label: Number of Floors
floorCount.description: Total floors including the ground-floor lobby. Adds real floor plates, walls, windows and upper-floor balconies; the roof and terrace follow the height. The original asset is an exterior shell with no interior room partitions, so rooms per floor are not adjustable.

windowOpacity.label: Window Opacity
windowOpacity.description: 1 preserves the original opaque glazing; 0 hides the glazing and its dark backing. Affects windows and entrance glazing, not balcony railings. Transparent windows reveal an unfurnished shell, not modeled rooms.

facadeColor.label: Facade Color
facadeColor.description: Light exterior walls, floor trim, balcony slabs and roof parapets.

accentColor.label: Dark Accent Color
accentColor.description: Central facade panels, entrance canopy, sign background, rooftop enclosure and balcony planters.

woodColor.label: Cedar Panel Color
woodColor.description: Vertical cedar accent panel and rooftop decking. Lighter wood slats and furniture retain their original contrasting finish.

windowColor.label: Primary Window Tint
windowColor.description: Tint of the darker seeded glazing variation; visible when window opacity is above zero.

windowLightColor.label: Secondary Window Tint
windowLightColor.description: Tint of the lighter seeded glazing variation; visible when window opacity is above zero.

scale.label: Overall Scale
scale.description: Uniform scale of the complete building and landscaped base, independent of the structural floor count.
